title: How to make enemy animations appear in front-view battles?

posts.author: Ju_De
posts.body: So basically, when an enemy uses an ability in front-view battle, the animation doesn't show (I suppose its because the party members aren't on screen for the animation to target?), but I want the animation to show. How do I do this? I've tried messing with animation settings, but idk man.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
But animations need an object to indicate the position on the screen.
The only plugin that looks like what you described is this one:
Dreamon_FrontView Actors & Hit Animations by Rattacookie
Bring true actors and real hit-target animations to RPG Maker MZ front-view battles.
rattacookie.itch.io

Front view actor sprites?
